## Summary

I implemented the `TextDocument` refactor across the language server, threading a single document value through the tool interface and worker layer instead of separate URI/content parameters.

**`crates/oxc_language_server/src/lib.rs`**
- Added the public `TextDocument<'a>` struct (`uri: &'a Uri`, `language_id: LanguageId`, `text: Option<String>`) with a `new(...)` constructor. Being a `pub` item in the crate root, it's exported as `oxc_language_server::TextDocument`.

**`src/tool.rs`** — Updated the `Tool` trait: `run_diagnostic`, `run_diagnostic_on_change`, `run_diagnostic_on_save`, and `run_format` now take `&TextDocument`.

**`src/file_system.rs`** — Added `get_document<'a>(&self, uri: &'a Uri) -> TextDocument<'a>`, which builds from the stored entry or falls back to `LanguageId::default()` + `text: None`. It's implemented on top of the existing `get`, so `get` stays in use.

**`src/worker.rs`** — `run_diagnostic`/`on_change`/`on_save` and `format_file` now accept `&TextDocument<'_>`; the internal `collect_diagnostics_with` closure and the `handle_tool_changes` revalidation loop (via `get_document`) were updated accordingly.

**`src/backend.rs`** — All six call sites (`initialized`, `did_save`, `did_change`, `did_open`, `diagnostic`, `formatting`) now construct/pass a `TextDocument`, preserving prior behavior (e.g. `did_save` overrides `text` from `params.text`; `did_change`/`did_open` carry the change text and language id).

**`apps/oxlint/.../server_linter.rs`** and **`apps/oxfmt/.../server_formatter.rs`** — Updated the `Tool` impls to the new `&TextDocument` signatures, delegating to their unchanged internal `run_file`/`format_file`/`format_in_memory` helpers.
